key: SHAYMIN: Mi-mi-mi-mi?
en: SHAYMIN: Mi-mi-mi-mi?
ja: シェイミ: ミーミーミーミー?

key: Shaymin fled to the center!
en: Shaymin fled to the center!
ja: シェイミは中央へ逃げた!

key: SHAYMIN: Mimi?
en: SHAYMIN: Mimi?
ja: シェイミ: ミミ?

key: SHAYMIN: Mi!
en: SHAYMIN: Mi!
ja: シェイミ: ミ!

key: Mi!
en: Mi!
ja: ミ!

key: Mi!!!
en: Mi!!!

key: EVE: Your timing is as impeccable as always, \PN.
en: EVE: Your timing is as impeccable as always, \PN.
ja: イヴ: 相変わらず、完璧なタイミングね、\PN。

key: LUMI: Please do something!
en: LUMI: Please do something!
ja: ルミ: お願い、何とかして!

key: Something's gotten into her and she won't listen to me at all!
en: Something's gotten into her and she won't listen to me at all!
ja: 何かがお姉ちゃんに取りついちゃったみたいで、全然言うこと聞いてくれないの!

key: I feel like this is a really, really, really bad idea to even be trying again!
en: I feel like this is a really, really, really bad idea to even be trying again!
ja: もう一度こんなことを試すなんて、すごく、すごく、すごく良くない考えだと思うの!

key: You KNOW what happened last time!
en: You KNOW what happened last time!
ja: 前に何が起きたか、お姉ちゃんも分かってるでしょ!

key: I don't understand why you won't listen!
en: I don't understand why you won't listen!
ja: なんで聞いてくれないのか、分からない!

key: EVE: And you know what's at stake here.
en: EVE: And you know what's at stake here.
ja: イヴ: それに、あなたも何が懸かってるか分かってるでしょう。

key: I have a new tactic. That Flora girl knew what she was talking about.
en: I have a new tactic. That Flora girl knew what she was talking about.
ja: 新しい手があるの。あのフローラって子の話には、ちゃんと根拠があった。

key: Please do not get in my way.
en: Please do not get in my way.
ja: あたしの邪魔をしないで。

key: LUMI: \PN, are you really going to let her do this?!
en: LUMI: \PN, are you really going to let her do this?!
ja: ルミ: \PN、本当にお姉ちゃんにこんなことさせるつもり!?

key: EVE: Your trust is appreciated.
en: EVE: Your trust is appreciated.
ja: イヴ: 信頼してくれてうれしいわ。

key: LUMI: Please, you can't really believe that this is a good idea!
en: LUMI: Please, you can't really believe that this is a good idea!
ja: ルミ: お願い、これがいい考えだなんて、本気で思ってないよね!

key: What if it happens again!?
en: What if it happens again!?
ja: また同じことが起きたらどうするの!?

key: EVE: I understand that you're afraid, but I need your trust and cooperation as well.
en: EVE: I understand that you're afraid, but I need your trust and cooperation as well.
ja: イヴ: 怖いのは分かるけど、あなたの信頼と協力も必要なの。

key: Everything will be okay.
en: Everything will be okay.
ja: 全部大丈夫だから。

key: LUMI: You don't know that!
en: LUMI: You don't know that!
ja: ルミ: そんなの分からないじゃない!

key: You thought you had it right the first time too!
en: You thought you had it right the first time too!
ja: 前のときだって、うまくいくと思ってたんでしょ!

key: EVE: And now I have no small amount of experience, perspective, and data on top of that.
en: EVE: And now I have no small amount of experience, perspective, and data on top of that.
ja: イヴ: 今はあのときと違って、経験も、視点も、データも十分にある。

key: LUMI: Even just having a third person here makes me nervous!
en: LUMI: Even just having a third person here makes me nervous!
ja: ルミ: 三人目がここにいるだけでも、あたしは不安なのに!

key: And I know how much being trapped with him hurt you!
en: And I know how much being trapped with him hurt you!
ja: あの人と閉じ込められて、お姉ちゃんがどれだけ傷ついたか、あたしは知ってるんだから!

key: I don't want you to have to risk it for me!
en: I don't want you to have to risk it for me!
ja: あたしのために、そんな危険を冒してほしくない!

key: I'm not the scared little kid I used to be.
en: I'm not the scared little kid I used to be.
ja: あたしはもう、昔みたいな怖がりな子供じゃない。

key: I can handle whatever happens-- now and afterwards!
en: I can handle whatever happens-- now and afterwards!
ja: 何が起きても、今も、この先も、ちゃんと受け止められる!

key: EVE: You won't have to.
en: EVE: You won't have to.
ja: イヴ: そんな必要はないわ。

key: Just let me do this.
en: Just let me do this.
ja: あたしにやらせて。

key: LUMI: No!
en: LUMI: No!
ja: ルミ: いや!

key: EVE: ...\PN.
en: EVE: ...\PN.
ja: イヴ: ……\PN。

key: I don't want to have to ask this, but could you deal with her?
en: I don't want to have to ask this, but could you deal with her?
ja: こんなお願いはしたくないけど、あの子を何とかしてもらえる?

key: I just need a little more time to finish this.
en: I just need a little more time to finish this.
ja: これを終わらせるのに、もう少しだけ時間が必要なの。

key: LUMI: I-- I don't want to do this...
en: LUMI: I-- I don't want to do this...
ja: ルミ: あ――あたし、こんなことしたくない……

key: But if this is really how it's going to be...
en: But if this is really how it's going to be...
ja: でも、本当にこうなるっていうなら……

key: I'll fight to protect your happiness too, Eve.
en: I'll fight to protect your happiness too, Eve.
ja: あたしも、お姉ちゃんの幸せを守るために戦うから。

key: I'll fight the entire world for you if I have to!
en: I'll fight the entire world for you if I have to!
ja: 必要なら、世界中を相手にだって戦ってやる!

key: P-please, this is her life too...
en: P-please, this is her life too...
ja: お、お願い、これはお姉ちゃんの人生でもあるんだから……

key: LUMI: I don't want you to sacrifice yourself anymore!
en: LUMI: I don't want you to sacrifice yourself anymore!
ja: ルミ: もうこれ以上、自分を犠牲にしてほしくない!

key: Not for me--
en: Not for me--
ja: あたしのためになんて――

key: It's not worth it...
en: It's not worth it...
ja: そんな価値、ないから……

key: I'm not--
en: I'm not--
ja: あたしなんて――

key: LUMI: Th-thank you...
en: LUMI: Th-thank you...
ja: ルミ: あ、ありがとう……

key: EVE: Your concern is understandable.
en: EVE: Your concern is understandable.
ja: イヴ: あなたの心配は理解できるわ。

key: However,
en: However,
ja: でも、

key: Lumi cannot afford to let you stop me.
en: Lumi cannot afford to let you stop me.
ja: ルミ、あなたにあたしを止めさせるわけにはいかないの。

key: LUMI: Isn't that my right to decide?!
en: LUMI: Isn't that my right to decide?!
ja: ルミ: それを決めるのは、あたしの権利じゃないの!?

key: Don't I get a say in this?!
en: Don't I get a say in this?!
ja: あたしに発言権はないの!?

key: EVE: ...While I obviously cannot say 'no' to that, neither can I simply do nothing.
en: EVE: ...While I obviously cannot say 'no' to that, neither can I simply do nothing.
ja: イヴ: ……もちろん「ない」なんて言えないけど、だからといって、何もしないでいるわけにもいかない。

key: I will not stand down.
en: I will not stand down.
ja: あたしは引かない。

key: No matter what gets in the way...
en: No matter what gets in the way...
ja: 何が邪魔をしようとも……

key: You, or my sister, or the very forces of time and nature themselves...
en: You, or my sister, or the very forces of time and nature themselves...
ja: あなたでも、あたしの妹でも、時間や自然の力そのものだとしても……

key: I am not going to let her go.
en: I am not going to let her go.
ja: あの子を手放したりしない。

key: Do your worst to take her from me.
en: Do your worst to take her from me.
ja: できるものなら、あたしからあの子を奪ってみなさい。

key: The world always has.
en: The world always has.
ja: 世界はいつだって、そうしようとしてきたんだから。

key: ...Tch. Just where are your priorities?
en: ...Tch. Just where are your priorities?
ja: ……チッ。一体何を優先してるつもりなの?

key: LUMI: Please, I don't want you to sacrifice yourself for me anymore!
en: LUMI: Please, I don't want you to sacrifice yourself for me anymore!
ja: ルミ: お願い、もうこれ以上あたしのために犠牲にならないで!

key: EVE: And just what do you expect me to do?
en: EVE: And just what do you expect me to do?
ja: イヴ: それで、あたしにどうしろって言うの?

key: Sit here, forget everything I've studied-- everything I've learned for this specific purpose, and lose you too?
en: Sit here, forget everything I've studied-- everything I've learned for this specific purpose, and lose you too?
ja: ここに座って、これまで研究してきたこと、この目的のために学んできたこと全部忘れて、あなたまで失えって?

key: Do you think I could live with myself after that?
en: Do you think I could live with myself after that?
ja: それで、あたしが自分を許せると思う?

key: LUMI: I'm-- I'm sorry...
en: LUMI: I'm-- I'm sorry...
ja: ルミ: ご、ごめんなさい……

key: I'll just, um...
en: I'll just, um...
ja: あたし、その……

key: EVE: No, wait--
en: EVE: No, wait--
ja: イヴ: あ、待って――

key: EVE: ...Ugh.
en: EVE: ...Ugh.
ja: イヴ: ……うっ。

key: EVE: There's too much to be done already, and obviously I need to go talk to her now too.
en: EVE: There's too much to be done already, and obviously I need to go talk to her now too.
ja: イヴ: やることはもう山ほどあるのに、今度はあの子とも話しに行かないと。

key: \PN, can I ask for your help again, even after all this?
en: \PN, can I ask for your help again, even after all this?
ja: \PN、こんなことがあった後でも、また助けをお願いしていいかしら?

key: This New World environment is exactly what I've been waiting for-- for a number of reasons.
en: This New World environment is exactly what I've been waiting for-- for a number of reasons.
ja: このニューワールドの環境は、いくつもの理由から、まさにあたしが待ち望んでいたものなの。

key: The first reason is that I've confirmed that multiple Shaymin live here.
en: The first reason is that I've confirmed that multiple Shaymin live here.
ja: 一つ目の理由は、ここに複数のシェイミが生息しているのを確認したこと。

key: I'll explain the rest later, but I need you to collect several of them.
en: I'll explain the rest later, but I need you to collect several of them.
ja: 残りは後で説明するけど、あなたには何匹か集めてきてほしいの。

key: Let's say five in total should do.
en: Let's say five in total should do.
ja: 全部で5匹くらいでいいと思うわ。

key: If you can bring them back here, that should be adequate.
en: If you can bring them back here, that should be adequate.
ja: ここに連れて帰ってきてくれれば、それで十分よ。

key: I'll go... talk to her.
en: I'll go... talk to her.
ja: あたしは……あの子と話してくる。

key: We'll come to an understanding, don't worry.
en: We'll come to an understanding, don't worry.
ja: ちゃんと分かり合えるから、心配しないで。

key: Back soon--
en: Back soon--
ja: すぐ戻るわ――

key: Five Shaymin! Please!
en: Five Shaymin! Please!
ja: シェイミ5匹! お願いします!

key: EVE: I see you've found all five of them.
en: EVE: I see you've found all five of them.
ja: イヴ: 5匹全部見つけてきてくれたのね。

key: Your help is irreplaceable as always; thank you.
en: Your help is irreplaceable as always; thank you.
ja: あなたの助けはいつも本当にかけがえがないわ、ありがとう。

key: As for Lumi, she'll be fine.
en: As for Lumi, she'll be fine.
ja: ルミのことなら、大丈夫よ。

key: She's agreed to cooperate, but as a precautionary compromise, she'll be waiting elsewhere until the very moment we need her.
en: She's agreed to cooperate, but as a precautionary compromise, she'll be waiting elsewhere until the very moment we need her.
ja: 協力することには同意してくれたけど、念のための妥協案として、必要になる瞬間まで別の場所で待っててもらうことにしたの。

key: For now, we can continue.
en: For now, we can continue.
ja: とりあえず、続けましょう。

key: Our next step will be to remove the anomalous energy around these Shaymin.
en: Our next step will be to remove the anomalous energy around these Shaymin.
ja: 次の段階は、このシェイミたちの周りにある異常なエネルギーを取り除くこと。

key: My opinion is that this energy is something like leftover, junk material from the generation of these worlds and their Pokémon.
en: My opinion is that this energy is something like leftover, junk material from the generation of these worlds and their Pokémon.
ja: あたしの見立てでは、このエネルギーは、これらの世界とそこに住むポケモンが生成される過程で出る、いわば残りかすのようなものだと思う。

key: It appears to collect around the most powerful figures in these worlds like debris falling into a planet's orbit.
en: It appears to collect around the most powerful figures in these worlds like debris falling into a planet's orbit.
ja: まるで惑星の軌道に落ちてくる残骸みたいに、これらの世界で最も力を持つ存在の周りに集まるみたいね。

key: Depending on the amount of leftover material, it may or may not form into a proper aura, but even when it doesn't--
en: Depending on the amount of leftover material, it may or may not form into a proper aura, but even when it doesn't--
ja: 残留物の量によって、きちんとしたオーラの形を取ることもあれば、そうでないこともある。でも、そうでない場合でも――

key: EVE: ...It doesn't mean it's not there.
en: EVE: ...It doesn't mean it's not there.
ja: イヴ: ……そこに存在しないってわけじゃないの。

key: Here, I've linked the energies of all five of the Shaymin with each other to accentuate the anomalous energy and develop it into a tangible form.
en: Here, I've linked the energies of all five of the Shaymin with each other to accentuate the anomalous energy and develop it into a tangible form.
ja: それで、この5匹のシェイミのエネルギーを互いに連結させて、異常エネルギーを増幅させ、実体のある形にしてみたの。

key: This will allow us to deal with it directly in the usual way.
en: This will allow us to deal with it directly in the usual way.
ja: こうすれば、いつも通りのやり方で直接対処できるようになる。

key: You know, witless violence and all that.
en: You know, witless violence and all that.
ja: つまり、脳筋な暴力ってやつでね。

key: By purging the aura ahead of time, we'll be preventing any unexpected interferences.
en: By purging the aura ahead of time, we'll be preventing any unexpected interferences.
ja: あらかじめオーラを浄化しておけば、予期しない干渉を防げるはずよ。

key: I'd like to take no chances, thank you.
en: I'd like to take no chances, thank you.
ja: 賭けはしたくないから、よろしくね。

key: Now, I believe that violence is your specialty, so I'd like to ask you again to help with the honors.
en: Now, I believe that violence is your specialty, so I'd like to ask you again to help with the honors.
ja: それで、暴力はあなたの得意分野だと思うから、もう一度、その役目をお願いしたいの。

key: Allow me to heal your party now as apology for before...
en: Allow me to heal your party now as apology for before...
ja: さっきのおわびに、パーティーを回復させてあげる……

key: EVE: ...There.
en: EVE: ...There.
ja: イヴ: ……これでよし。

key: Speak to me when you're ready to begin.
en: Speak to me when you're ready to begin.
ja: 準備ができたら、話しかけて。

key: EVE: Are you ready?
en: EVE: Are you ready?
ja: イヴ: 準備はいい?

key: EVE: Wonderful.
en: EVE: Wonderful.
ja: イヴ: よかった。

key: I'll do my best to assist as well.
en: I'll do my best to assist as well.
ja: あたしもできる限り手伝うから。

key: EVE: Let's begin.
en: EVE: Let's begin.
ja: イヴ: 始めましょう。

key: Miii~
en: Miii~
ja: ミーィ～

key: Shami?
en: Shami?
ja: シャミ?

key: EVE: ...Good.
en: EVE: ...Good.
ja: イヴ: ……いいわ。

key: EVE: Now, it nearly happened in that battle, but...
en: EVE: Now, it nearly happened in that battle, but...
ja: イヴ: さっきの戦いでほとんど起きかけたけど……

key: EVE: Now, the next step...
en: EVE: Now, the next step...
ja: イヴ: さあ、次の段階よ……

key: In order to do this properly, we're going to need to transform this whole area.
en: In order to do this properly, we're going to need to transform this whole area.
ja: これをちゃんとやるには、このエリア全体を作り変える必要があるの。

key: I'm going to coordinate a five-fold Seed Flare attack to purify the entire space.
en: I'm going to coordinate a five-fold Seed Flare attack to purify the entire space.
ja: 5匹同時のシードフレア攻撃を組んで、この空間全体を浄化するわ。

key: Then we can get what we need.
en: Then we can get what we need.
ja: そうすれば、必要なものが手に入る。

key: EVE: All right, Shaymin. Don't fail me now.
en: EVE: All right, Shaymin. Don't fail me now.
ja: イヴ: よし、シェイミたち。ここで失敗しないでね。

key: Seed Flare!
en: Seed Flare!
ja: シードフレア!

key: EVE: Take your time.
en: EVE: Take your time.
ja: イヴ: ゆっくりでいいわ。

key: Whatever's worth doing is worth doing well.
en: Whatever's worth doing is worth doing well.
ja: やる価値があることは、ちゃんとやる価値がある。

key: Shaymin Quest completion has been detected from a different save file.
en: Shaymin Quest completion has been detected from a different save file.
ja: 別のセーブデータで、シェイミのクエストクリアが検出されました。

key: Skip finding Shaymin on this file?
en: Skip finding Shaymin on this file?
ja: このファイルでは、シェイミ探しをスキップしますか?

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
